name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.10.13
mac.notes:
New:

* Folders inside folders: New Nested Folder in a folder's right-click menu, and a folder dragged onto another goes inside it; Import from Arc keeps them nested
* Create a Space looks like Arc's
* Archive Other Tabs, Archive Tabs Below and Archive Tabs Above in a tab's right-click menu
* Separate From Pinned Tab on a pinned tab that has left its page
* Copy All Links as Markdown in a folder's right-click menu
* Copy URL (⇧⌘C) leaves trackers out; Copy URL as Quote (⌃⇧⌘C) links to the selected text
* Cycle Tab Backward and Forward (⌃⌘← and ⌃⌘→) go through tabs in the order you viewed them
* A tab using the camera, microphone or screen sharing shows it in the sidebar
* Open Link in Peek in a page's link menu, and ⌥⌘-click opens a link in Little Qube
* Archived Tabs can be filtered on how the tab was closed
* Library › Media also shows the Desktop
* Interface Scale and Default Page Zoom offer 50 %
* The Streaming Space has Back again
* Quitting asks first while a download is running

Fixed:

* Clicks that stopped working and Control, Option or Command that stayed held after a prompt, menu or drag
* Dragging something onto a page (such as a website builder's canvas) works again
* A page under the open Library no longer reacts to the pointer
* Back and Forward sit centred at every Interface Scale
* The sidebar's icons are Arc's soft grey
mac.summary: More of Arc: folders inside folders, Create a Space as Arc's, new tab and folder menu items, and stuck clicks and keys fixed.
